en: Color postcard showing a stone lookout or refuge building with a small tower and adjacent tall metal lattice observation/telecommunication tower on a hilltop. People walk toward the building and others sit on red benches under large trees. The reverse side has divided back layout with printed Hungarian and Cyrillic text identifying the place as Pécs, Misina-tető, publisher details from Budapest, and the photographer's credit.
